event.headline: Returned on their own in 3h 12m. We spent nothing.

diagnosis.narrative: UPI collect request timed out at 14:32. This customer has timed out twice before and completed payment within four hours both times.

decision.explanation: Every intervention costs more than the margin it would add. This customer recovers on their own 61% of the time after a UPI timeout, and a 10% incentive would buy 13 points of uplift for ₹340 of margin on a ₹3,400 cart worth ₹748 in gross profit.

audit_trail.summary: payment_initiated with no terminal state for 30 minutes.
Chose HOLD — no action beats doing nothing.

event.headline: Recovered after a free reminder — the incentive offer was capped by the 24h contact policy.

diagnosis.narrative: Issuer declined with a generic do-not-honour code. No pattern of prior declines on this instrument.

candidates.block_reason: Blocked by policy: Maximum 1 message per customer per 24h.

decision.explanation: NUDGE_INCENTIVE had the highest raw EV but was blocked — this customer already received a message in the last 24 hours. NUDGE_FREE is the best remaining allowed action and clears the minimum edge on its own.

messages.body: Hi Rahul, aapka ₹1,180 ka order abhi bhi pending hai. Card details saved hain, ek tap mein complete karein: hold.app/r/8f2k

audit_trail.summary: NUDGE_INCENTIVE blocked: max 1 message / 24h already used.
Payment completed 30 minutes after the message.

event.headline: Flagged farmer (score 0.71) — incentive withheld. Cut off at ₹0 cost.

diagnosis.narrative: UPI timeout, but the pattern underneath is different from a typical timeout case: 9 of his last 11 abandonments converted within 30 minutes of receiving an incentive. That is a learned response, not friction.

candidates.block_reason: Blocked by policy: No incentives to flagged farmers.

decision.explanation: This customer’s farming score crossed 0.65 this run. NUDGE_INCENTIVE is removed from the action set entirely for flagged farmers, and every remaining action costs more than the margin it would add. We hold, and pay nothing.

audit_trail.summary: payment_initiated with no terminal state for 30 minutes.
farming_tier=flagged (score 0.71) — NUDGE_INCENTIVE removed from candidate set.
Chose HOLD — every remaining action is negative EV.
No further contact; event expired unresolved after 14 sim-days.

event.headline: Routed to a human — ₹31,800 renewal flagged as possible fraud, above the ₹25,000 threshold.

diagnosis.narrative: Renewal declined with a risk flag from the issuer, on a plan worth ₹31,800. The confidence interval on recovery is wide enough, and the value large enough, that this should not be resolved by formula alone.

decision.explanation: Value at risk is ₹31,800, above the ₹25,000 threshold for automatic action, and the recovery confidence interval straddles a wide range. Policy 10 routes this to a human for review rather than acting automatically.

audit_trail.summary: Analyst confirmed the card and renewal completed.

event.headline: Paid on their own 3 days later — the scheduled retry was cancelled before it fired.

diagnosis.narrative: Renewal declined for insufficient funds two days before this customer’s inferred salary date (the 1st of the month). Retrying now would likely fail again; scheduling for the salary window is the higher-odds move.

decision.explanation: Scheduling the retry for the customer’s inferred salary date clears the minimum edge with room to spare.

actions.cancel_reason: Customer paid manually before the scheduled retry executed.

audit_trail.summary: Scheduled retry for inferred salary date (+6d).
Customer paid manually 3 days in — scheduled retry cancelled.

event.headline: This customer’s first order — an ops analyst sent a reminder anyway, and it worked.

diagnosis.narrative: Card limit exceeded on a first-time customer’s very first order. No history to score against.

decision.explanation: Engine recommended HOLD — the model edge was below the ₹5 minimum on a cold-start customer with no history. An ops analyst overrode it: first-order customers are worth a free nudge even at thin model confidence, since a bad first experience is costly beyond this one order.

messages.body: Hi Farhan, your order for ₹620 is still waiting — your card details are saved, so you can finish in one tap: hold.app/r/8f2k

audit_trail.summary: Card limit exceeded on first order.
Engine chose HOLD — edge too thin (cold start, no history).
Human override: send NUDGE_FREE regardless — first-order customer.

event.headline: Recovered after an 8% incentive — genuinely price-sensitive, not a repeat pattern.

diagnosis.narrative: Issuer decline with no retry pattern. This customer has never received an incentive before and their abandon-to-convert timing is irregular — the opposite of a learned farming pattern.

decision.explanation: The smallest incentive that clears positive EV is 8%. Farming signals are low, so the incentive cost is genuinely incremental spend, not a discount being farmed.

messages.body: Hi Saranya, ungal ₹1,560 order innum complete aagala. Adutha 2 mani neram-la order pannina ₹125 discount kidaikum: hold.app/r/8f2k

audit_trail.summary: Low farming score (0.21) — incentive spend treated as genuine.
Chose NUDGE_INCENTIVE at 8% — smallest incentive clearing positive EV.
Sent Tamil WhatsApp message with incentive.

event.headline: Immediate retry succeeded — bank gateway outage had already cleared.

diagnosis.narrative: Gateway-side timeout consistent with a known issuer outage window. Historically resolves within minutes.

decision.explanation: Gateway success rate has already recovered to 94% in the last 10 minutes. An immediate retry clears positive EV cheaply.

event.headline: Retry timed to the 7th (inferred salary day) succeeded on the first attempt.

diagnosis.narrative: Insufficient funds, five days before this customer’s inferred salary date of the 7th. Retrying now would likely repeat the decline.

decision.explanation: Scheduling for the inferred salary date turns a low-odds immediate retry into a high-odds one.

audit_trail.summary: Scheduled retry for inferred salary day (+5d).

event.headline: Card expired — retries blocked by policy. Sent an update-card link instead.

diagnosis.narrative: Card on file expired last month. No retry will succeed against an expired instrument — this needs a new card, not a retry.

candidates.block_reason: Blocked by policy: No retries on expired_card / mandate_revoked.
Blocked by policy: No retries on expired_card / mandate_revoked.

decision.explanation: Retrying an expired card can never succeed, so both retry actions are policy-blocked. A free update-card nudge is the only path to recovery and it clears positive EV easily.

messages.body: Hi Priya, the card on file for your ₹2,240 order has expired. Update it here and we'll retry automatically: hold.app/r/8f2k

audit_trail.summary: RETRY_NOW and RETRY_SCHEDULED blocked — expired instrument.
Chose NUDGE_FREE with an update-card link.
Customer updated card and renewal completed.

event.headline: Held — the model’s confidence interval on retrying straddled zero. Recovered anyway.

diagnosis.narrative: Opaque issuer decline on a customer with only 11 days of history. The model has too little signal to be confident either way about whether a retry would help.

decision.explanation: The best candidate has a positive point-estimate EV, but its confidence interval crosses zero — we are not sure it actually helps. Value at risk is below the ambiguity-escalation threshold, so we hold rather than escalate.

audit_trail.summary: Chose HOLD — best candidate CI straddles zero.

event.headline: Positive-EV incentive sent, capped for watch-tier — customer still did not return. Marked lost.

diagnosis.narrative: Watch-tier farming score (0.48). Incentive capped at half-strength rather than withdrawn — the signal isn’t strong enough yet to remove it entirely.

decision.explanation: Capped at 5% (half the standard rate for watch-tier customers), the incentive still cleared positive EV on the model’s estimate. The customer did not convert — a reminder that a correct expected-value decision is not a guarantee.
